name: Artlist
description: Israeli creative-content platform founded in 2016 that licenses royalty-free music, sound effects and stock footage (Artgrid) to video creators under subscription, and runs the Motion Array templates marketplace and FXhome video software. It reported ~$260M ARR at end-2025 and is pivoting toward an AI-native creative suite.
services: Subscription licensing for creators and brands

relations.note: US video-templates marketplace (founded 2013) acquired Dec 2020, reportedly ~$65M; operated as an Artlist brand

notes: Founded at Kibbutz Afikim. ~500 staff before a June 2026 reorganisation that cut ~200 roles; size band reflects post-cut estimate. Artgrid is an in-house brand (launched 2019), not an acquisition. Motion Array kept inside this record (US-founded, no separate Israeli entity confirmed).
